pages.title: The Momentum Firm | Public-Sector Consulting
pages.description: Public-sector consulting that helps government, education, and nonprofit organizations move ambitious priorities from paper to practice — improving how they operate, deliver, and serve.

pages.title: Our Capabilities | The Momentum Firm
pages.description: Five practices for public-sector organizations: enterprise strategy and transformation, analytics and operational intelligence, implementation management and oversight, organizational change management, and program design and evaluation.

pages.title: Social Impact | The Momentum Firm
pages.description: Pro bono and low bono design thinking workshops and training for smaller organizations, and community grants for social innovation and economic empowerment.

pages.title: Client Industries | The Momentum Firm
pages.description: We partner with mission-driven organizations across state, local, and federal government, intergovernmental organizations, K-12 and higher education, nonprofits, and public health.

pages.title: Mindful Momentum | The Momentum Firm
pages.description: Research, frameworks, and field notes for public sector leaders who have to deliver in public — whitepapers on mayoral agendas, human-centered AI, 311 analytics, and high performance organizations.

pages.title: About the Firm | The Momentum Firm
pages.description: Founded by Lakeisha Sesay, MPA, The Momentum Firm exists to close the gap between intention and impact for public sector and social impact leaders.

pages.title: Our Offices | The Momentum Firm
pages.description: The Momentum Firm works from Atlanta, Washington, D.C., Los Angeles, Houston, and New York City, staffing engagements from whichever office is closest to the work.
